Overall, the price is about right.

title: It's Earl Grey, man.
text: "Hand selected premium black teas from Asia provide the foundation for this regal blend. But it is the essence of Italian bergamot, a fragrant orange, which gives Earl Grey its flavor and aroma of distinction." There's that word 'regal'. Have you ever met someone who used that word in a sentence? And not as a joke? "Higgins & Burke excites your senses with premium teas that will inspire and revitalize you. Indulge...Escape." It's Earl Grey. I steeped it for three minutes and I steeped it for five minutes. I had it plain and with 1/2 & 1/2. It's still Earl Grey. Don't get me wrong, I like it. But please, tooting your own horn gives me a headache. Guess I'll go drink more tea now.

title: Good Taste
text: MIO Liquid Peach Tea has a great taste. The bottles are small so you can toss one in a backpack or purse and take it with you to add to your bottled water. It is easy to add too much to your water so start slow and taste first before adding more. I would really recommend this.

title: Great gift
text: I bought one of these for myself and one for a gift. It is elegant and practical.

title: So Far sooo Good?
text: This doesnt taste half as bad as some of these reviews are letting up. The licorce taste is there but its very subtle! Its well worth it in the long run and adding honey helps. Go for it mommy's!!!! Your baby is sooo worth it!

title: Blackberry Vanilla Herbal Tea
text: I received this item through the Amazon Vine Program. My overall impression of this tea is that it is alright, but nothing to get excited about. Let me be more specific: The predominate flavor that comes through is Hibiscus, which makes sense since it is the number one item in the list of ingredients (ingredients are listed from the largest concentration to the lowest concentration in the product). If you are a fan of hibiscus, this will not bother you. The blackberry is in there, but I have a very difficult time finding any vanilla flavor. No where in the list of ingredients is vanilla listed. The tea bag is unique, but I am not sure that it really adds anything. In fact, it seems to take a bit away in the aspect that it does not appear to be a recyclable material. Paper composts well, but I am not sure about the material that this weave is made from. There is no indication on the package as to what is being used. As for brewing, I do not find that this bag allows it to brew any faster or better than any of the bags that I have used on other products, including ones from Lipton. While this is an ok tea, I do not find anything in it to make me want to recommend it to anyone.

title: Strange texture and taste turned me off
text: I was intrigued by the flavor combination of this; I had never thought to try aloe as an ingredient, and even if I had, I would have never paired it with passion fruit. So I went in curious. I was disappointed. The drink looks strange - olive green with translucent, slightly darker green bits floating in it (the thick opaque label hides this fact at first glance). But I was okay with that. One swig, though, and I felt like I was chewing my drink - the bits are slimy and numerous. The taste was pretty sweet at first, but I did not the tinge the aloe gave to it, and the aftertaste sticks with you. A few swigs later, I resigned that I wasn't even going to finish the bottle. It was tehn I noticed that the bottle isn't one serving - it's 1.4375 servings (an 11.5-ounce bottle with a serving size of 8 ounces). This strikes me as a ploy to make the nutritional info look better. All in all, I won't be drinking this again, unless it's free and I have no other option, and even then I would have to think about it.

title: Heavenly
text: Addicted to tea and this is the perfect solution. PG Tips is wonderful. I know it isn't the classiest tea available, but for the price it is a treasure. A good strong tea.

title: Lovely Tea
text: I am a tea drinker and love to try new varieties of tea. The Blackberry Vanilla from Lipton is a lovely, naturally decaf tea. I love the Pyramid tea bags and do think they make a difference when brewing herbal teas. Herbal tea (which actually contains no tea at all) generally has larger pieces of the ingredients than traditional black or green teas. The pyramid shape of the tea bag allows those pieces more room to spread through the water so the infusion of flavor is stronger. The Blackberry Vanilla tea is a beautiful purple color which is actually from the hibiscus not the blackberry (although I'm sure the blackberry does contribute some of the color). Despite the name the hibiscus is also the dominate flavor which is true of most herbal infusions. The blackberry and vanilla flavors are undercurrents and I wish these flavors had been a bit more prominent. Overall I enjoyed the Lipton Blackberry Vanilla tea and I'm sure it will be a variety that I will purchase in the future.

title: My favorite Tea!!! No other Raspberry compares!!!!
text: My favorite tea is raspberry flavor and I have tried every one I have found in the stores. This one is by far my favorite! The flavors are so sweet and I have been able to give up coffee for this one! This is a great price too if you buy two 6-packs you save the shipping. At my local store I can get this tea for $0.15 per bag but on here it works out to $0.11 per bag, which would save me $9.60 on that amount of bags.

title: Simplemente funciona, SUPER recomendado
text: Me dieron dos cajas cuando nació mi hija, y yo simplemente no confiaba mucho en el tema. Pero es ABSOLUTAMENTE maravilloso. De efecto rápido (mucho más que el motilium) y son de gran eficiencia. Muy recomendado para quién necesite producir más leche

title: shorted 1 bag in order
text: I love this tea but I was shorted 1 bag, and I counted twice. I bought 100 and not 99.

title: My favorite tea
text: Stash Black Peach tea is the best peach tea I've ever tried and I'm a lifetime fan. I used to buy it directly from Stash, but this was a better deal. Very, very satisfied and highly recommend it.

title: A sweet taste, but not overpowering
text: This is a really nice infusion, with a sweet blackberry taste that is refreshing and not overpowering. There is not much of a vanilla taste that I can tell, however I smell a hint of vanilla as I drink it. The teabags themselves are great, in a pyramid shape that helps it to infuse but with no leaking. I like that it's clear so I can see the herbs inside. I would definitely recommend this tea to anyone who likes the taste of blackberry, although not to someone who is hoping for a distinct vanilla flavor.

title: Nothing special
text: I generally like aloe pulp drinks. I enjoy little pieces of aloe gel, and Chantea has a lot of them. I also generally like green tea and passion fruit flavors, but I did not like the flavor of Chantea it reminded me of a tea that was made with hard water. I also thought Chantea is a bit on the 'too sweet' side. I would not buy this product.

title: Peach Tea MiO smells like chlorine
text: I was shocked to find this issue. I put the glass under the noses of three co workers and they all said the same thing "Chlorine" we then dumped it, started again with a new glass of water to make sure it wasn't something funny going on with the water itself. Same issue. I can understand how different people may detect different things and some like and some hate a chemical flavor or odor, but what I don't understand is why Kraft would pass this off when so many people DO think it smells like chlorine. It is truly offensive (the odor) to a LOT of people.

title: Musty Smell and Poor Taste
text: The packaging was very musty smelling! After through out the shredded paper and airing it out for weeks, the smell has come out of the boxes to the point that I may consider using them for something. The tea itself had a terrible taste! I bought another box of the same tea somewhere else and it's not so bad as what arrived in this set. Still, I'm not very impressed with the taste of the tea. Also, the flowers in the set did not have good color and were very drab. Also, the teapot holds a very small amount, as others have said. I would not recommend this at all.

title: Thumbs Down on Taste; Thumbs Up For Convenience
text: This pertains ONLY to the Lipton To Go Stix ( Lipton To Go Stix Iced Green Tea Mix, Tea and Honey, Mango Pineapple, 10-Count (Pack of 4) ) product with the honey, mango and pineapple flavor. I had thought this would be a product I'd enjoy as mango and pineapple are two of my favorites when it comse to fresh fruit or smoothies; I've also been a Lipton tea customer for years, and have never been disappointed in their products. I even enjoy honey on occasion as a more natural sweetener, and was curious to see how these flavors would combine. This one was such a disappointment that I gave away what was left in my sampler box (my friends and family didn't care for it either). Now I liked the convenience of the stix, and have appreciated what companies have done in order to give you a somewhat cheaper form of "flavored water" so I thought Lipton might have had something. The honey was so prominent and overly sweet that it pretty much wrecked the remaining flavors; it also had a slight chemical tinge which left me with a horrible after-taste in the end. What there was of the mango and pineapple was not the fresh taste I had hoped for, but something with a disgusting artificiality that did not play up a combination which does work very well under most circumstances (such as when I've made up my own mixture); again there was way more artificial sweetness (and this is coming from a Southern girl who loves sweet iced tea on occasion). Even the fragrance was sickening and overpowering. The color in a 16.9 ounce bottle of water was a straw-yellow -- not quite golden, not quite regular yellow, but I figured that meant it would be strong enough to give me the full flavor I desired without being too weak. As I mentioned, I could only take several sips; I think I drank 1/3 of a bottle in the end...and then I called it quits. I even refrigerated it for a bit, as if hoping everything needed time to "merge"; after a few hours I tried again -- lost cause and down the drain it went. I don't know if the other flavors are an improvement, but I will never waste money to find out. Had the box I received NOT have been a sampler courtesy of Lipton, I would have demanded a refund. Back to the drawing board Lipton!

title: AWFUL- AWFUL- NASTY- HORRIBLE
text: Do your research on this... the main ingredients are chemicals, ie propylene glycol. I got my 4 bottles from Amazon... opened one bottle, squirted some into a tall glass of ice cold water and could not wait... well... EEKKKKK... so gross. It tasted like pure sugar water with a weird aftertaste, squirted some more and finally got the "hint" of tea taste... You have to squirt A LOT to even taste a hint of tea and when the main ingredients are chemicals (excluding water of course) it tastes like what it is.. A CHEMICAL. I immediately put the bottle back into the box from Amazon, along with the 3 unopened bottles and tossed them in the garbage. While I hated to spend $12+ of my money for NOTHING.. it's my fault, I should have done reviews FIRST. Here's just one I found: [...] The cute bottle and the 0 calories in the commercials were enough to entice me and I am sure this product will make millions from idiots like me who fell for this, but trust me people, SAVE YOUR MONEY. I don't write much reviews, but I just had to come on here because I am trying to go green and avoid as many chemicals as I can for my own body and home and this is just one big giant chemical hidden in a cute bottle with a great commercial. Look up the ingredients, which are NOT on Amazon and do your own research. Pour a glass of water, squeeze some lemons and add stevia for some lemonade with no chemicals.... Or brew some tea bags, put in pitcher, refrigerate, add stevia for some sweet tea... it will be better for you and taste better than this crap. Lesson learned... Now choose for yourself, if you buy it... remember I warned you ;)

title: I'm not a fan of English Black Tea, but this will satisfy your needs
text: Length:: 1:17 Mins See video. I rarely drink black tea, but for those who like it, this product will serve them well. I would have given it 2 stars because I really don't like black tea, but I want to be a fair tester. Someone who wants black tea will be happy with this product; hence, 4 stars. Good packaging.

title: 10 squirts and it was bleh.
text: I started with 5 squirts of the tea and that did nothing but color the water a smirky brown. I added 5 more squirts and it tasted like watered-down day old McDonald's sweet tea. It was just too lemony without having a true sweet taste. I wouldn't purchase again and don't recommend either.

title: Quite good!
text: This is passion fruit flavored green tea with aloe vera pulp. I really didn't know what to expect, but it sounded good. Here is what I thought, from start to finish: The bottle looked as interesting as the drink sounded, bright colors, bold text. Parts of the bottle are clear and you could see the liquid inside. It is a light, clear-ish color and you could see the pulp floating through the whole bottle. When I opened it it smelled good, like I would expect green tea and passion fruit to smell. I took a small sip with no pulp and it tasted good. The next sip I tried the pulp, it is hard not to get the pulp. They are large juicy bits and the only way I could describe them was like the inside of an orange. Have you ever pulled the membrane off a segment of an orange and then pulled the little juice filled pieces out? It is like all the little tiny juice filled pieces floating in the drink. As much as I thought it would be just OK, I found that I really enjoyed it. It was quite good and I kept sipping, deciding I liked it even better, and then I finished the bottle. If you like green tea flavored with fruit and wouldn't mind the juicy bits (much better than pulp), then I would suggest giving this a try. I am certainly going to get more, and I think I will be trying the lemon flavor, too. Yum!

title: OMG!!!
text: I love this Chai Tea, i normally bought my chai tea from starbucks, but since we moved to the most northern town BARROW, AK, theres not such a thing. I ordered this tea and it is even better than starbucks, i will order this tea soon again

title: no returns
text: I ordered three of these and one came with no packing around it and the pot was broken. When I went online I found there were no returns on this item. I am VERY disappointed.

title: Best flavor additive!
text: The entire family enjoys these. They give good flavor for those times you want something besides water. I would rather not have artificial sweeteners & additives but sometimes water just doesn't satisfy. I do like that you can add as little or as much as you want. I tend to waste the powdered additives or add it to a LOT more water while hubby prefers his drinks sweeter. It's tasty and has a good tea flavor, slightly artificial tasting but to be expected. Would definitely buy again.

title: Very Pungent Tea
text: This tea is very pungent and flavorful. One cup of it will be enough to keep you awake for quite a while and will fill the whole house with a very soothing aroma. it is perhaps even better chilled with a little milk.

title: Tasty But Aloe Vero "Floaties" Put Me Off
text: Although I am a big tea drinker, both hot and cold, I don't normally drink green tea as I enjoy a nice black tea taste and have never bought it as a beverage. Therefore I didn't really know what to expect when I got the Chantea Aloe Vera Green Tea - Passion Fruit flavor. However, I was pleasantly surprised - the green tea taste is mild and there is a really nice passion fruit flavor. Now for the big "BUT". The Amazon page says that the bottle contains "real Aloe Vera pulp" which I also assume is infused with passion fruit since if you chew it that's what the taste is. However, I've seen Aloe Vera and it's a succulant and the pulp that's in the bottle looks similar to orange pulp, so maybe its passion fruit - the label doesn't say anything more helpful. There isn't alot of it in the bottle, but the color of the drink combined with the pulp gives the strong impression that something inside went bad (or worse - it gives the impression of looking at pond water with floating bugs and stuff). Maybe that's why the label is opaque, wraps around the entire bottle, and goes from the base all the way to the neck - the marketers have figured out the public doesn't want to see all that stuff floating around in their drinks. So the drink is actually quite good - I'd probably buy it again just for the taste - but I don't really like anything hard in my drink (which is why I don't but pulpy orange juice) and thus the pulp in the drink is just a little too much to take.

title: Helps slow breast milk production
text: Used this to help slow breast milk production when I was breastfeeding. Worked well! I drank 3 cups a day.

title: Mio...MY OH!
text: I love flavored water...I must admit I have used Mio before and really have enjoyed trying their assorted flavors. I think the one thing that I love most about this product is that you can make your water flavor as weak or strong as you would like to. My daughter likes it a bit more flavorful than I do...so that's easy enough to do, you don't have to open another 'flavor baggy' or container, just put another squeeze into the water and stir...boom...there ya go! What an easy way to get more water into your life! AND at a much more cost effective manner than purchasing bottled teas/flavored waters.

title: The real green tea
text: I love the green tea Japanese restaurants serve. The tea is strong and very green in color. For years I could not find similar tea in any Asian grocery stores. My colleague gave this tea bag for me to try. Wow! It is exactly like the tea you get in a Japanese restaurant. Amazon is offering it at an amazing price. I cannot be happier with it.

title: flavorful....
text: This tea (chai) has a great blend of spicy flavors (gingery, etc) in addition to being invigorating (yes, this is black tea). For me, all it takes is a little splash of milk and a drizzle of honey, blended in, and I am one happy camper!

title: Tepid Tea
text: I have always enjoyed a good "cuppa" and thought I had a lucky break when I had a chance to sample this new tea through the vine program. Unfortunately, the only good thing I can say about it is I didn't have to pay for it. Folks, I gave it every chance. I brewed it strong, medium, weak. I had it plain, with milk, with lemon. I offered it to friends and family both tea lovers and haters. And we all had the same reaction: It has no flavor! For some reason, this tea is absolutely tasteless, flavorless and insipid. So what to drink? If you like a strong cup with milk you can't beat Yorkshire Gold. Awake by Tazo is a close second. If you prefer it medium strength Twinnings English Breakfast or PG Tips will do nicely. And while I'm at it, the most outstanding Earl Grey I've ever tasted was Rishi Silver Needle Jasmine. Impra Black Currant makes a lovely iced tea. All of these may be purchased here at amazon.

title: Moroccan Mint Tea
text: My wife & I enjoy this tea and really like the flavor. We think it is better than other Moroccan Mint teas that we have tried. Because it does have some caffeine, we drink it only in the morning or early afternoon.

title: Tasty With A Great Aroma
text: This is a great tea - good flavor and aroma, and very smooth. As other reviewers have noted, it is less bitter than some other Earl Greys I have tasted. A good tea!

title: Yuk!
text: As someone who is trying to lower their caffeine intake, I looked forward to recieving this. I enjoy green tea and thought the taste would be refreshing for the summer. Too bad then that it tastes like mango flavored medicine. I took one sip and gave the rest to a relative.

title: Not a fan of the Sweet Tea flavor..
text: I tried MIO when it first came out and enjoyed the fruit punch flavor. A couple squirts in a bottle of water turned it into a tasty flavored treat. I decided to try this sweet tea variety, and I wasn't too impressed. The flavor just seems off to me, not what I'm accustomed to enjoying from sweet tea. I tried it with just one squirt and with a few, the flavor seems off either way. I'd suggest if you're new to MIO, try one of the other flavors first to see how you enjoy it. If you're a huge sweet tea fan, this may suit you but it didn't sit well with me or my household. Overall, I still prefer Crystal Light packets in my water over MIO, as the flavor is more consistent and they're cheaper where I purchase them in bulk.

title: Awesome tasting, convenient, tastes great, but...
text: It could be the sweetener that I might be allergic to it?, but after drinking this stuff, my mouth gets coated & I feel incredibly thirsty & dehydrated. Flavors are great (I HAD to try another flavot, the black cherry, to see if it was the flavoring - same result!) Has malic acid in it, and a few vitamins, yet can't read all the ingredients, so not sure if the problem is the dyes or the sweetener - could be either causing that severe thirst, which is why we want flavor/vitamin-enhanced water to begin with. I don't care that it's 0 calorie or not, but would LOVE to see these in the same form only with a sweetener & perhaps without the colors, that don't cause a reaction... This stuff should be labeled the "diet" version, as many of us have problems with diet sweeteners, OR, better yet, they could use something like "EZ Sweets", that most people don't react to adversely, unlike "Nutrasweet" & other zero-calorie drinks & drink mixes. If the color was gone or at the VERY least the sweetener changed, I'd give it 10 stars out of 5, if I could! This is a great idea for every day, to throw in your purse, car or whatever. The sweetener tastes OK, but either the sweetener or dyes cause extreme thirst, gas, and I don't feel well at all after drinking this stuff. Fun for college & HS students who seem to want to see who can drink it the strongest, or even right out of the bottle, which is VERY small & makes more servings than it says. Bottle says "24 servings", yet I think that's for large glasses (maybe 24oz or so?) The 1st time I tried it, I followed the directions & it was FAR too strong, so it only takes a little to go a LONG way! IF the sweetener (& possibly coloring) is changed & I don't get a bad reaction, and the taste is as good (I know the EZ Sweetz sweetener is fine), I'll be buying a LOT more of this stuff for the car, the house, my purse, overnight bags, traveling, etc.

title: A Science Experiment
text: I thought the concept of this was awesome. The packaging seemed prefect for portability; small with a spill-free pop-top. It is available in nine flavors - Berry Pomegranate, Sweet Tea, Peach Tea, Mango Peach, Orange Tangerine, Fruit Punch, Strawberry Watermelon, Black Cherry and Green Thunder. Just a squirt or 2 and I would have favor-enhanced water on the go. The reality was slightly different. Although the packaging is small, the spill-free pop-top LEAKS. I received the Sweet Tea flavor to sample. The flavor was very inconsistent - sometimes a squirt would be enough for an 8 oz. glass; other times 2 or more squirts were needed. It was almost like a science experiment (LOL). Often I would have to pour it out and start over; once I had added too much the taste would be overwhelmed with an artificial chemical-like sweetener taste. YUCK!!!!!

title: I like it
text: First let me say that I am a cold tea drinker or i like ice in my tea and only on really cold outside conditions do I ever drink hot tea. Lipton has a really unusual bag here and already have a few of their flavors but wanted to try the blackberry. Although the box states it is Blackberry Vanilla, the vanilla is just a hint of a flavor and that is alright with me. The flavor is mild and there are only 18 bags in this box whereas most of the other teas like Bigelow and Tazo have 20 in theirs. But, the price is slightly lower at the store where I checked but not only are the number of bags lower, the ounces in the bags are lower too. I can't see where the different tea bag actually makes the flow any better. I tried both of the different bags and both floated for a time if I didn't push them down. This is a nice flavor but it is so mild that it is almost non existant and i had to use another bag to get a good bold flavor. This flavor is caffeine free, which is a plus for night time use.

title: Pass the honey...
text: It's a good thing this tea actually works as it's supposed to... because it tastes so, SO bad! I went from pumping 8 oz/day at work to 11 oz/day by the end of a week, and that was only using the tea twice a day. I'm not a tea fan to start with, and this has a very strong anise flavor... also not a favorite. With enough honey, I can tolerate it. The results are worthwhile.

title: Delicious, fresh green tea blended with maccha powder
text: I grew up with green tea (I'm from Japan)- I was always searching for good alternative to the loose green tea (wanted something quick, single serving, easy to clean, and yet tastes good). Well, my search is over, finally! Pros -Tastes very fresh, the color is very green, not that yellow-ish green -Added Maccha to enhance the flavor Cons -The naming is bit confusing. I can see why some people order this product, thinking that they are getting the Maccha powder (the one for the tea ceremony). This is NOT a 100% Maccha poder. It is a delicious, fresh green tea blended with maccha powder. Quick Tip If your green tea tastes too bitter, the water might be too hot. The best temperature is around 80C (176F- NOT boiling hot). After pouring the hot water, steep about 30-45 sec, then take the bag out. You never want to "cook" the green tea. Hope this helps :)

title: Nice Flavor
text: This product have a nice flavor and the fruit pulp added a nice twist. It was sweet, but not an overpowering sickly sweet.

title: Enjoyable Cold Beverage
text: I found this beverage quite refreshing with an exotic, alluring, fruity flavor. Definitely a change of pace. It does contain sugar so diabetics may have to wait for the artificially sweetened version. Also, it comes in a plastic bottle. I prefer glass bottles. I realize glass increases the price and so will probably be getting harder to find. But I would love to enjoy this same product from an ice cold glass container.

title: Sip the incipid
text: The matcha content is too low to matter falvor-wise, and the tea itself is sadly incipid. I use only about 5 oz water, and the tea is still too bland, yet with slite bitterness. I much prefer, fo example, Barry's green tea, with no matcha promises, but a strong rich flavor, and a price signifly less than this stuff. Gonna buy some good quality matcha and add it to green drinks, rather than brew a cuppa 4 or 5 times/day. And just as important, more points off for excess packing. Let's not forget nylon, as in nylon teabags, and that junk sticks around--who needs it!

title: lipton goes luxury
text: A pleasant addition to the Lipton line of teas. The blackberry vanilla is a blend of several fruits and flowers including Hibiscus flowers, Rosehips, sweet Blackberry leaves, dried black currant pieces, dried blackberry pieces, dried blueberry pieces, dried raspberry pieces and some "natural" flavors. You do need to infuse the recommended time of 4-6 minutes to release the full flavors of the tea. The dominant flavor is the blackberry as expected in the name. We enjoyed it both hot and iced. The pyramid bag design most closely mimics an infuser which is often used for higher end and bulk teas. It seems to work allowing the flavors to escape through the skin of the bag. A nice product and presentation.

title: I'm pleased
text: Well, I don't claim to be a tea expert. My basis for comparison is Lipton's Orange Pekoe and Black Tea, which I drink regularly and like. So, this tea I judge as just as good and perhaps a touch better, a bit richer. And, it does seem to dissolve fast, maybe a testament to its richness. So, between the two, I prefer this, but not enough to change because of the cost and what I judge as only marginally better with regard to its naturalness claim. Its claim for being ethically produced, I think worthy, but really can't judge and I haven't heard anything bad about Lipton's processes. That said, if its cost is not important to the buyer and/or its claim of ethics is important enough, I recommend this because I judge it a superior tea based on what I like, as described in this review.

title: Packaging more suited for metal screws not teabags
text: The packaging does not match what is show on the website. The teabags came in a box suited to hold metal screws not teabags. The teabags were tossed in there like screws as well. So, unless you plan to store your teabags in your garage at your workbench, do not order these. I ordered these as a subscription which I am now cancelling.

title: Too Much Control
text: I can't get the hang of this MIO liquid coloring/flavoring stuff. I feel like there is an optimal amount per ounce to add and that I have gone over or under that amount in every attempt. If I could find the sweet spot, perhaps I'd like the product more. I think I prefer to have a standard dose of a flavor additive. I was interested to try it for a long time and excited when it became available through the Vine program because I had not seen it in stores. When it arrived, I was in a new place with a sink that produced nasty tap water. Adding MIO made it nasty tap water with a funky fake tea taste. Fast forward to after I tried it in filtered water--still a funky fake flavoring taste. I might try it again in another flavor--I haven't had tea-flavored water products before. Maybe a flavor that was just fruity as opposed to imitating a favorite beverage of mine (sweet tea) would be more flavorful. In general, I'd prefer plain water to this stuff.

title: Helpful Lactation Aid
text: This product was recommended to me by both my midwife and the lactation consultants at my hospital's breastfeeding clinic. On the days I would drink this, I was able to notice a difference in the amount of milk produced while pumping at work. I struggled with production, and would usually be able to pump 9 or 10 ounces instead of 7 or 8. I imagine if you produce more overall, you would hopefully see a similar increase percentage wise. A few things to note that are not on the box: You can make a large batch in the beginning of the day, and then drink throughout the day, either by reheating or chilled, and it will not lose it's potency...same with being able to mix with other teas once brewed if you find the taste undesirable. Since it is imperative that you follow the brewing directions that require seeping, while covered for ten minutes, these are a few tips the lactation clinic suggested to make sure it was easier to fit into my day as a working professional.

title: The best green tea!
text: I have never liked green tea very much before, but I love this green tea. I drink it constantly. You can make iced tea easily by steeping the tea bags in cold water for only three minutes. Yummy!

title: Best Tea Ever
text: I tried this tea in a sampler pack and became totally addicted! I moved and could not find any stores that carry the flavor so I have to buy online. It is a very sweet and strong tea that requires no sugar or milk. I guess it tastes like black licorice, but I never eat it so I'm not sure.

title: Lemon Tea
text: Love anything Lemon...this is decaf white tea. It is hard to find in any stores, so I get it here on Amazon. Good price - fast delivery. Great fresh light tea for summer.

title: Tastes like dessert
text: For licorice lovers only. Intense licorice flavor and is naturally sweet, so needs no sugar or honey. Drinking a cup is like eating licorice for dessert, without the calories.

title: Summertime
text: This makes the best iced tea ever.And in the winter I can drink a cup hot and remember that summer is not "that" far off.In Momtana, in the winter, we appreciate any thing that reminds us of summer.

title: Didn't work for me
text: I ordered this item in hopes that it would help me with my milk output. Right now I am barely keeping up with as much as my 4 month old will eat. However, after using 5 out of the 6 boxes in my initial order, I saw absolutely no increase in my output. I was really disappointed as there are so many awesome reviews. Good luck if you intend to try it. Just didn't work for me.

title: super yummy sweet taste!
text: If you aren't familiar with the taste, I can only suggest you try it before you end up with 6 boxes of the stuff. But if you are a committed lover of this tea, then Amazon's Subscribe and Save is REALLY a great deal! Definitely not for people who do not like the taste of black licorice. I personally steep the tea for longer than advised on the package but I like my teas strong (package says 3-5 minutes, I go for 10). I have turned some of my licorice loving friends onto it - 1 is a diabetic and she LOVES it since it gives a really sweet flavor with NO sugar or carbohydrates. It is wonderful on a cold evening and won't keep you awake as there is NO caffeine.

title: It's Like Drinking A Sharpie Permanent Marker
text: Are you familiar with the chemical smell that emanates from the tip of a Sharpie? That's what your water will smell like when you put this in it. No matter how much of this concoction I mixed into my water, it failed to taste like sweet tea. It did have a tea-like taste but I'd put it somewhere between Snapple peach and raspberry teas. If you're a fan of sweet tea just go buy some from the store or make your own; stay far, far away from this stuff.

title: Wow
text: I am a big fan of English Breakfast teas and I have to say that I really like this tea. I can't say that I am too familiar with the Higgins & Burke brand, but I am impressed with the quality of their offering. It had a nice, mild flavor, but didn't tase "weak" like some mild teas do. Some people don't like mild tea, I am a fan of it in the mornings, or as a relaxing cup in the evening, so if you like very strong flavors, then I wouldn't recommend this (unless you want to use two bags per cup). It also has a bit of a bitter aftertaste, which I think is characteristic of English Breakfast teas, but it's not overpowering or terrible. My wife likes her tea a bit sweeter and a little stronger than I do, but she did like this when she tried it plain (and liked it more when she added a bit of sweetener!). I would definitely recommend this tea ot any English Breakfast or black tea fan. It was also nice to see that this brand is part of the Ethical Tea Partnership.

title: Great if you like Wintergreen
text: Although I do not care for this tea much, I still give it four stars. That is because it is the only tea I can force down that has wintergreen in it. I often buy teas that are a mixture of green and/or white tea with spearmint and/or peppermint. It was my fault I did not read the description carefully, as I did not realize it had wintergreen in it until I tasted it. You can definitely taste the wintergreen! My favorite Stash teas are the White Christmas, (white tea, peppermint, & ginger), and the Moroccan Mint, (green tea, spearmint, lemongrass, & peppermint). I do the White Christmas if I want something a bit spicier and more warming, and I do the Moroccan mint when I want something a little smoother. Due to the lemongrass it does taste a bit grassy, but it's still good. If you want a good mint tea without green, try the Cascade mint. It just has peppermint and spearmint, and is absolutely delicious! I mix that with decaf green in the evenings and it's wonderful! Unfortunately, I have not found the Cascade mint in boxes of 100, so I usually stick with one of the other varieties mentioned above. Bottom line, I have come to love most of the Stash tea flavors that contain mint, with the exception of the Merry Mint. Like I said though, I can kindof get it down, which is more than I can say about other teas with wintergreen in them. And these boxes of 100 are such a great value, as I drink several cups per day!

title: Great gift
text: I loved the tea set, and with the deal I got on Amazon, I was able to buy two of them for the price of one. The only fault we found with it, is the tea kettle is a bit small. However, the 9 varieties of tea that come in the tea set are fantastic, and the blooms are beautiful. Well worth the price I got on Amazon. And the bamboo box that the set comes in is very handy, now I have a nice place to store all of my teas, and when some one comes over, I can present them with this beautiful bamboo box full of teas, it's FANTASTIC!

title: Best tea!
text: I never drank hot tea. I am 50 years old, from the south until a friend of mine turned me on to British Tea. Loved it. Problem was the only way to get it was to order it from England. You can't get it here in the states. Then I moved to Texas where Central Market is. I found this tea and like it about as much as the Salisbury Brand. It's rich, full bodied. Not watery at all. Have me a cup every morning and sometimes(especially in winter, it's Texas you know) in the afternoon. Can't go wrong with this one. Now my teenage son drinks it too, he likes it better than coffee.

title: Nice packaging
text: You really need HOT water to make these open up..tea will probably be cold by the time the flower opens ..maybe I did something wrong..give them the benefit of the doubt

title: Very high quality tea
text: Many of the common brands of herbal teas are not palatable to me. This one is very good. I enjoy it. Easy on the palette and easy on the digestion track. Yum! Just like any high quality tea.

title: Too Sweet and artificial tasting!
text: I used one packet of this in water and, though, it tasted like a sweet tea; the taste was artificial. I am not too keen on trying this product again.

title: Good, cheap, hearty
text: I wouldn't buy this for my house, but I always welcome a cup when out and about -- it's better than most brands of earl grey carried at cafes! It is hearty with a strong bergamot flavor. This tea outperforms earl grey by: Mighty Leaf, Choice Organics, Celestial Seasonings, Tea Gschwendner, Numi It seems on par with: Tazo, Republic of Tea It is not as good as: Revolution, Far Leaves

title: Good value
text: Stash chai tea is tasty and the large box was perfect for ordering tea for my wedding favors. It doesn't hurt that the dark red bags go well with my colors either :) I ordered this along with a box of 100 Bigelow English Breakfast tea bags with the free super saver shipping and they arrived together within a week, so I'm pretty satisfied.

title: One bag 3 cups
text: This tea is wonderful, one bag will make three cups for most people. I like my tea very strong so these were perfect. I bet they will be good for making a good ice tea.

title: A Warm Season Beverage
text: Not what I would call a cold season tea, Blackberry Vanilla Caffeine Free Herbal Tea from Lipton has a very interesting fruity flavor, more reminiscent of a spring day than the upcoming fall season. The tea has a strong tart side so I would recommend reducing the brew time from the recommended 4 to 6 minutes. Do not be put off by the deep red color, it makes you think raspberry but that is not the flavor that you will taste. For a change, I brewed four pyramid bags in three cups of water and after it cooled, poured it over a glass of ice. This is my preferred method of drinking it. I do not like sugar in my tea, but decided to give it a little whirl. Something happened with this mix, because I came away with an artificial aftertaste. If you prefer more of a black tea taste in you iced tea, add an extra Lipton orange pekoe bag. A perfect combination. Overall, a good product for warm weather drinking, excellent iced and the tart flavor hits the right spot.

title: I like this tea, but it does lack something.
text: I think it's like another reviewer said, it really lacks a good black tea body. I love the intense spiciness, but clove dominates. In fact, the clove is so intense, that it numbs my mouth half way through a cup. I don't mind because it reminds me of when I used to smoke kretek, but others might.

title: Fish tea
text: I know nettle tea has a pretty distinct taste, but this particular brand was just unbearable. The smell reminded me of fish food pellets, and it had a fishy taste, too. I bought a pound of loose nettles from somewhere else for a lot cheaper, and the taste is so much better.

title: It doesn't work as it supposed.
text: We bought 6 boxes. and drink the tea every day, did see any improvement unfortunatedly.

title: Very Grassy Flavor & Weak Tea
text: I bought this green tea from Amazon because of strong reviews. I have tried it twice on two different days, steeped according to directions on the bag the first time and then steeped for 15 minutes the second time. I have to say I hate this tea! Very grassy in flavor and watered-down for what's left over! I am a long-time tea drinker and occasionally buy more expensive loose-leaf green tea from Japan. This Kirkland Matcha blend is NOT high quality green tea. I am giving this tea two stars instead of one because I can understand how people who do not know how to brew tea can complain about its bitter tannic taste. I also give credit to Kirkland for putting more volume of tea in the bags. With this tea, it will never be bitter because the flavor is completely weak! If you've tried something like Bigelow Green tea and hated its bitter taste, you might think this Kirkland Matcha tea is the top of the line. But it is not! First, the Bigelow will never be sweet like authentic loose leaf green tea because it was not dried and packaged correctly. Second, brewing it for longer than 4 minutes will make it dark yellow and bitter. But this Kirkland brand is much worse because it only looks green like the authentic green tea, yet tastes nothing like it! I continue my search for a convenient high-quality green tea and will resort to Bigelow for quick fixes if I can't find anything satisfying in the meantime...

title: Very good, and a lot of it
text: If you haven't bought a 240 count package of tea before, let me tell you how much it is. A lot. That's how much. This is the church's morning tea supply for the next few months. The pyramid teabag is very nice. The bag material appears to be a standard tea bag like the kind used by Celestial Seasonings, but the four corners of the bag were formed into a pyramid instead of a square. A tea bag, of course, will retain some air as it is steeped. A square tea bag will float flat on the surface of the water. A pyramid, on the other hand, floats as an upside down pyramid. I don't know why the air doesn't collect in one of the corners, but it doesn't. Bottom line: the rest of the bag, and thus the tea, is submerged, which makes for a (in my opinion) much better steep than a square bag. The tea itself is quite enjoyable, although I am not a connoisseur by any means. I use one bag in the morning to make about a liter of tea, then down it with a big breakfast. This tea is not as in-your-face earthy as the last black tea I tried (a Yorkshire blend), and I like it better. It still has that earth and slightly bitter flavor, but it is a little sweeter than the Yorkshire blend I tried, probably because it is made from the tips of the plant, as the product name states, or perhaps it came from a different and better crop, or some other reason that I do not know. I am not one to add anything to my tea for sweetening or any other alteration, so I prefer this tea. There's just a ton of it. Two-hundred forty tea bags in an absurd quantity.

title: very tasty but bags leak the very finely crushed leaves
text: Before trying this tea I'd been drinking the packets my husband brought home from Japan. The stash had the same nutty flavor of the good japanese green tea but the bags were fragile and leaked tea leaf into the cup. Just a personal pet peeve. I bought the Stash green tea based on a review I read in Men's Health magazine that rated Stash as having the highest level of anti oxidents (and Caffeine) in those tested.

title: Blah taste
text: So i tried this one day and was naseuous after drinking one serving mixed with water. Maybe it was funky artificial mango pineapple taste? Or the artificial sweeteners in it? Either way it was pretty nasty.. I wouldnt drink this again nor offer to anyone.

title: FREAKIN AMAZING STUFF :D
text: Delicious stuff. No Joke. i actually like this tea..i'm not exactly a tea drinker, but i drink it at least one thing of tea a day..mainly cause of the benifits long and short term. I'm not as lazy as i used to be, n i just feel 100% more ALIVE lol..yea i'm kinda being overdramatic, but i can't get enough. i learned a lot about this stuff from my health class in college. the blend of GREEN and WHITE tea is AMAZING FOR YOUR HEALTH!! if u googled the benifits of green and/or white tea u'd definitely wanna get some of this stuff for urself! ;P

title: Good tea
text: Having lived in England for 10 years, finding 'real' tea after moving back stateside was a challenge. I was so pleased to find real English PG Tips available on Amazon. I bought 6 boxes of 240 bags. That should hold me until my next group of British friends come to visit me and re-supply my tea cupborad.

title: worked for me!
text: I really love the taste! I think it helps increase production although you have to drink a lot of it to see the difference. I love the taste anyway so it's easy to drink a lot of it. It definitely helped keep the supply up once I went back to work. Even my little one enjoys a few sips now and then.

title: Too Chunky
text: I enjoy drinking a variety of teas - green, black, fruit, etc - and I thought the combination of Passion Fruit, Aloe and Green Tea would be a good one. Unfortunately there was far too much pulpy material to make drinking the tea enjoyable. The flavor was good, but I found myself wanting to strain it, in order to drink it from the bottle. It almost reminded of a bubble tea because the chunks of Aloe were so thick and numerous. If the pulpy material won't bother you this tea is fine, otherwise I'd avoid it.

title: A for effort, but D for results
text: The idea behind this product is quite good - a small container of drink concentrate that you can add to water anywhere and have an instant soft drink. Sadly, the product is not as good as the idea. The problem is the taste. I have tried various tea products, including Crystal Light, and have generally not been too impressed. Sadly, this MIO stuff tastes very artificial, and not at all pleasing. I tried it out on the kids, to see if it was more in their range, but even they did not like it. Sorry, MIO - A for effort, but D for results. (Review of MIO Liquid Peach Tea)

title: Peach Tea
text: We found very little peach flavor in this "peach tea". It is a poor substitute for Twinings.

title: My daughter loves it......and I don't.
text: I have never tried Mio but my daughter had tried the Pomegranate flavored one which she liked but thought it was quite strong. We received the Sweet Tea flavor and my daughter tried it in her bottled water. My daughter absolutely LOVED it! She thought it was much better than the previous flavor she tried. It supposed to last 24 servings (a serving size is 1/2 tsp). I suppose depending on how strong you like your tea how long those 24 servings would last. It says that you use one squeeze for 8oz of water. It has -0- calories, it does NOT need refrigeration but says that for best quality use within 1 month of opening. The Mio is sweetened by sucralose and acesulfame potassium (as per label). UPDATE: I tried the Mio...and I've tasted sweet tea but this tastes terrible. Perhaps I like lemon tea because this doesn't taste like sweet tea I've had. My daughter still loves it though....

title: Interested taste
text: This black tea had a very interesting taste. It was kind of strong for my taste, but nevertheless it had a comforting taste. The tea is very strong, so I suggest using the minimal amount of tea bags when making tea for multipe cups. It's good to keep in the cubboard for company, but I don't think I would purchase it for myself.

title: Stash tea is the best, herbal tea for me
text: The stash teas are handy, with great flavor at a good price. I usually get wild raspberry. I got mango/passion fruit this time. I just drop it in a mug O' room temp water, and keep topping it off as I drink it. It is naturally sweet enough for me- un adulterated. No caffeine, no sugar, and so pleasant. Handy in the foil packs, and simple packaging. The foil packs make it nice to put a couple in your pocket or pack, or give a few to a friend.

title: Basic Lemon Ginger Herbal Tea
text: *** Stash's Lemon Ginger Caffeine Free Herbal Tea is a basic lemon ginger tea, tasting strongly of ginger, and full of flavorings, and oddly, even contains soy. This is one of the better commercial highly processed, non-organic teas. I much prefer organic teas that are made without artificial flavorings and certainly without soy, but if you are not picky about herb teas, and are looking something very strongly flavored as an introduction to the world of teasans and decaffeinated beverages, this would be fine. If you like your tea more subtle, with true pure tastes, and can discern complex differences between natural and commercial teas, then this definitely is not for you, and I would recommend any Numi tea, Yogi Tea, Traditional Medicinals, or even Stash's organic line of teas (which comes in a wonderful Lemon Ginger Organic Tea!) Stash Lemon Ginger Tea contains ginger root, lemongrass, lemon flavor, safflower, hibiscus, citric acid, and soy. Unfortunately, nothing special. ***

title: Great convenience product!
text: Well, was this ever a nice surprise! A bitty squirt, and I DO mean bitty, into a glass of water and voila! Instant peach iced tea! The flavor is quite nice, sweetened but not so much so that it gags you, and the peach flavor is quite present but not overpowering. It is very refreshing, just awesome actually. One of those products you literally stumble upon and see yourself using it the rest of your life. Kids love it too so that's the ultimate test in my book! It's best with ice cubes though - the flavor kinda grabs you otherwise. You don't need much - just a bit of a squirt into an 8-ounce glass of water and you're done. The package will last for about 10-12 glasses of good tea, which isn't too bad and it doesn't need refrigerated after opening. You need to use it within 30 days, however, after opening. Great product, a great idea and a very fast pick-me-up at work. Highly, highly recommend!

title: Yummy Blackberry Tea
text: I have only recently become fond of drinking hot tea and usually prefer a spiced chai. I decided to take a chance on the Lipton Herbal Pyramid Tea Bags when they were offered as a choice in the VINE program. I am so glad that I did. This tea has a strong real blackberry flavor that is good with or without cream. When I added half and half, I almost thought I was drinking a blackberry cobbler with ice cream which is a good thing when you need to avoid desserts. I shared a cup with a friend last week who also loved it. I'm pretty sure she will buy some for herself soon. The only negative thing I noticed is that my half and half curdled when added to the hot tea. I thought I might have some bad milk but it only curdled in the blackberry tea and not my coffee or chai. I'm not sure what to think of that but it still tasted just fine.

title: Good, but pricier than my standby (Taylors Yorkshire Gold)
text: This is a good, well-rounded, mellow English breakfast tea, an Assam/Ceylon blend. It has a distinctive, sort of floral undertone or aftertaste, not unpleasant but unusual. I prefer to do without the additional packaging of individual foil packets. And today's Amazon bulk price is $0.18 per for Higgins & Burke compared with $0.11 for my favorite everyday bagged tea, Taylors Yorkshire Gold. I won't be switching brands, but I'll enjoy the rest of this box. If you're a tea-drinker, you probably have a good idea of what you like in a black tea. There are many good ones to choose from. I have my favorite, but that's a personal thing based on my budget and taste. Above all, I'm grateful to Amazon for providing us with such variety and reasonable pricing.

title: Not my favorite flavor
text: I love Stash mint green & white teas but this is not my favorite variation. It's much better over ice than warm so I think I'll use my purchase to make lots of iced tea. To be fair, it's a high quality tea. I think I really wanted a real mojito.

title: It works!
text: I have used this product for quite some time on and off. It is easy to use, drink a cup before bed and excellent results in the morning. It is very beneficial for those times when life gets you out of sync.

title: Decent
text: The best thing about this tea is that it is unusual. I received it as a gift as I am a tea lover. The tea tastes pretty good, but no better really than your average box of tea and not as good as many of the loose leaf teas I have tried. I would possibly gift it to someone who is beginning to like tea only because it is a unique gift, not to those who might be "tea connoisseurs" of sorts.

title: strong smooth tea with an aromatic bergamot scent and taste
text: I am totally addicted to this! i drink it every morning when i wake up and usually have one cup after dinner, . Bergamot is supposed to have properties that aid in digestion and calm your stomach, which i believe in. I have tried severl other brands but none even come close to the quality of stash.

title: Green Tea
text: I find Kirkland Green Tea to be a very nice smooth tasting tea. Kirkland Signature Ito En Matcha Blend (Green Tea), 100% Japanese Green Tea Leaves, 100 Tea Bags

title: Jury is still out
text: I gotta say that I was really excited for this product-- it was the perfect gift for my mom-- but not so happy with how it all worked out. My biggest issue? The flowers didn't always open the way they were supposed to, and even when they did I sort of felt like I was drinking tea with a giant sea anenome stuck in the teapot. The tea itself was pretty good, and it's still an interesting novelty gift (more power to these people for coming up with this idea), but I just don't think it's all it's cracked up to be. I'm going to try some more soon, so my opinion may change, but right now, I'm a little disappointed.

title: Great flavor, but you've got to like 'sweet'
text: MIO Sweet Tea is indeed 'sweet', so if you don't like sweet things, don't bother with this flavor enhancer for your water. The tea flavor does come through too, but it's subtle. No strong aftertaste with this flavor of MIO and all things considered, it really is one of the best I've tried from their many flavors. I kept thinking to myself as I sipped away on my Sweet Tea flavored water - "If I was on a diet and needed something sweet instead of a soda, this would be it!" So if you're looking for a sweet with no aftertaste drink, that is as close to a regular soda in that 'sweetness', snag some MIO Sweet Tea flavored drink enhancer. If you are more inclined to enjoy diet sodas, you'll find this too sweet. Backing off the amount in your drink doesn't really help much as for me at least, the tea flavor was always much fainter than the sweetness.

title: Gross
text: Tasted artificial, weird, unnatural. Could not detect the orange peel "note" at all. Singular, not balanced. Very pretty color and pleasant aroma. Unfortunately, I sent it back ):

title: Great flavor with no aftertaste.
text: Almost every add-in powder or liquid flavoring that I've tried has had a pretty bad aftertaste. With this Lipton To Go Stix I didn't experience an aftertaste at all. The honey, mango and pineapple flavors were all very subtle but mixed well together. I highly recommend this product for anyone who enjoys flavored tea.

title: Over all, fairly good
text: I have tried spiced chai tea, but it did not have enough spices. I also tried a mix where you just add water, but they were too sweet. I prefer a stronger spice flavor and I like to be able to control the amount of milk and sugar. So, I usually make my own chai spiced tea from scratch. I get just the right amount of ingredients, but it is a lot of trouble and takes time. Then I tried the Stash Double Spiced Chai Tea. With more spice than most other teas I found the flavor and intensity to be fairly close to my home-made chai. This chai tea is able to maintain the flavor of the black tea with a nice blend of spices that give it a little extra kick with the double-spice. Of course, with more spices comes more bitterness. The way to lessen the bitterness is to slightly increase the milk and sugar. A better way to help cut the bitterness is to use honey instead of sugar. I will still make my own home-made version when I have the time to make it. But, I will also use this Stash Double Spice Chai Tea as an alternative until I find something better.

title: Nice cup of tea!
text: I am a confirmed tea addict, and I keep a wide selection of regular, flavored, and herbal teas on hand, so the chance to test a new flavor of herbal tea was a no-brainer. I was more than pleasantly surprised to find that, though this is an entirely herbal concoction, it has the nice flavor of black tea. I don't know how they did that. There's a definite blackberry taste and the vanilla keeps all the other flavors calm and happy, but whereas some herbals have an overpowering single-flower note (usually some sort of citrus stomping heavily on the lighter flavors), there is no such thing going on in this cup. Honestly, I would not have expected such a nice touch from Lipton. I tend to be a little tea-snob, and I would have expected this from one of the exotic producers of primarily herbal blends. My hat is off to Lipton for out-herbaling the best of the rest. Highly recommend this lovely, caffeine-free herbal for any time of the day or night when only tea will do.

title: refreshing
text: Well, I assume most people who buy this have tried it once before and are buying it because they know they like it. However, if you are buying it without trying it then i can tell you that its got a great flavor of pepppermint and leaves you feeling fresh. I liked it and I am not very big on tea either, so i'd say its got a good flavor

title: yuk

title: best tasting Green Tea
text: I've tried hundreds of green tea brands from China, Japan and Korea and US. This is the best tasting green tea ever without the dark residue, sediments and bitter taste. This is very high quality and the taste is clean & fresh. will continue to order from Amazon..

title: Nice tasting, pretty looking tea!
text: I have seen Numi teas around at my local coffee and tea shops. I found this on a Gold Box Deal and decided to try it out. I like how the tea bud blossoms and looks so nice when the tea is steeped. The only negative is the small teapot. Even pouring it into a cup when the tea is steeped needs to be done with caution. Otherwise for the price, its a nice variety of special teas, for any occasions!

title: Shipping Charges
text: The product was fine, but the cost of shipping was more than the cost of the tea. Won't make that mistake again.

title: Tastes ok but..
text: So i bit the bullet and got the Mio Liqud. This flavor tastes.. ok. It has a funky fresh aspartame kinda taste to it. I dont like diet sodas at al because they give me head aches (allergy to the artificial sweeteners) and this had the same headache. I took out out just for some flavor to add when on some walks and or hikes etc.. I mean its nice to keep something portable in a bag and just add if you want for flavor in the water - but im not sure whats in it.. all i know is the taste n the headache.

title: fruit juice taste, diet friendly, healthy on-the-go drink
text: I must watch my calories, sodium, sugar, and fat due to health issues. Thus tea is a preferred drink over sodas. I want to live, and live a good lifestyle. This product helps. Expecting good taste since it is produced by Lipton, a favorite of mine and my wife's, this was hardly a gamble in trying. The flavor was excellent, strong, fruity, and actually better than expected. I've tried lots of flavored teas and usually have gone back to regular plain old Lipton. Fat & Sodium are 0. Sugar only 1g per 8 oz. and calories only 5. 10mg caffeine if that's an issue for you, not for me. After realizing the drink was a bit sweeter, like southern sweetened tea, and I'm used to less sweet, I tried mixing the drink with an equal amount of club soda. WOW. Even better. Now the Lipton Blackberry Pomegranate flavor was still there, less sweet, the drink had the fizz of soda, calories cut to 2 ½, and sugar only 1/2g. The drink came out as clear as sun tea. Kids will love this sweetness. Kids need drinks with low calorie count. That's becoming major for child health. Convenience is a plus, an easily opened individual tube of powder, travel friendly, a freshly mixed drink at work, or make it one bottle at a time at home. No more having several types of bagged tea on the shelf to mix one with another, and then a remaining half-pitcher of tea going funky in the refrigerator. This has a shelf life of well over a year. It is tons better than instant teas I've tried, easier storage than bottled brew, and has the refreshing taste that the world has come to expect from Lipton. My sample convinced me to begin converting from the mess of tea bags. Dare I mention this can be carried in a shirt pocket or purse to a restaurant and instead of ordering those overpriced drinks, ask for the free iced water, then pour in your Lipton, stir, and "Bob's your Uncle".

title: Very Interesting, Takes Some Getting Used To
text: I really enjoyed this drink, for a couple of reasons. First off, Chantea has a really nice taste. The texture of the liquid is very smooth, and while it's a little sweeter than I would have liked, it isn't cloying, and there isn't any of that artificial sweetener tang. You can definitely taste the tea, too. To my surprise, the aloe vera pulp really helped make the drink. It was a little bit startling at first, mostly because the pulp was really more like chunks. But again, it was good. The nutrition isn't too bad (heavy on the sugar, though, take note) and it's very refreshing. I'd recommend it.

title: Pulpy Sweetness
text: If you're the kind of person who doesn't like drinking anything that has stuff floating in their beverage, than this isn't the product for you. I usually stay clear of orange juice with pulp for this reason, and with this drink, you're guaranteed a mouthful of fruit viscera in every sip. Nevertheless, this green tea and passion fruit concoction is packed with sweet exotic flavor. If you can get past the clumps of fruit that pass through your gullet with every swallow you'll enjoy this beverage as a tasty alternative to your typical fruit juices. I wouldn't recommend this product if you tend to be more of a traditionalist with your tastes, but if you're adventurous and are open to slightly unusual but safe experiences, give it a try.

title: Very easy to brew, tastes and smells great, could be sweeter
text: Lipton Herbal Pyramid Tea Bags, Blackberry Vanilla These pyramid tea bags are quite functional by allowing the contents to release their flavoring more consistently and fully. Upon opening the box, I could smell the berries and vanilla which did not dissipate while brewing the tea. When the dried contents of the bag were reconstituted, I could tell that they're real berries. The tea tastes fairly smooth and I could detect its acidity. I think it would work better if it were slightly sweeter. The fact it is caffeine-free makes this a great tea to drink before sleeping. Overall: 5/5 stars, very easy to brew with the pyramid bags, smells and tastest great, could be slightly sweeter

title: good stuff
text: this red clover tea is worth my money, i have shed 8 pounds in 3 weeks, i know its not a diet tea or anything but, i drink this twice a day eat my 3 regular small meals, and a fruit or a rice cake or something lowfat, the tea coupled with better eating habits and i ride my exercise bike and do a few stretches, lunges, lift a 5 pound weight in sets of 5's twice, for about 15 minutes total2 times a day, nothing long and drawn out. before 3 weeks ago i honestly weighed 199, that's a lot of weight if you are 5'2, mostly in my butt and thighs. today i weigh 190, today meaning march 20, 2012. i have a long way to go but that is a good start for me i love food it is hard but i find lowfat and sugarfree things to snack on. being overweight makes you tired easily, and the more tired you feel the more you will just sit around and when you sit around, yep you tend to snack. my goal is 170 pounds, yea that is still a lot of weight but i am a realistic person, i will not set myself up for a let down. if a should lose anything beyond 170 i will be very happy, i will update my quest on april 20, 2012. thanks

title: Ahhh finally truly spicy chai in a tea bag
text: I once had a soy chai latte that blew my mind. I was driving through Missoula Montana. I have yearned for years to capture that taste again. I have tried chai after chai with no luck. This chai comes close. If you like spicey chai but without all the sugar and milk in the premixed, this may be your chai.

title: I don't get it
text: I was all excited about trying this after reading all the great reviews, but I don't like it- even with lemon and sweetener-tastes like dirt to me. The only type of green tea I've tried that I actually enjoyed is Yogi's Green Slim Life Blueberry. The search continues...

title: Blackberry Vanilla Tea
text: This tea smells so GOOD brewing! A nice strong yummy smell. I was just a tad disappointed that the taste wasn't quite as strong as the smell. It does taste good, just not as strong as I like my tea. (just brew it for a little longer than normal) I love the pyramid bag it comes in! I have found that tea that comes in the pyramid bags do seem to brew a better cup of tea. Grab a box of this Blackberry Vanilla Tea and brew yourself a cup.
